author: blu
body: Proves flying evasion on defence. A 4/4 flyer attacks into a 3/3 ground bear and a 0/4 reach wall. The AI must not chump-block the flyer with the bear (illegal); only the reach wall can block it. Before this the blocker AI ignored can-block and would assign a ground creature to a flyer, nullifying evasion -- Serra Angel and the dragons could be stopped by a bear.
